fundingAndSettlement.baselineShortfall: Platform baseline delivery subsidy when driver earning exceeds reference tariff. Do not charge merchant without an accepted funding term.
fundingAndSettlement.contractAndPromotionShortfall: Their separately authorized funding terms apply to the actual savings, not a second charge to the driver or duplicate platform subsidy.
fundingAndSettlement.budgetAndLiquidity: Use existing reservation/funding/liquidity guards. A low/free customer fee alone authorizes neither unfunded money nor a second wallet credit.
fundingAndSettlement.legacyPreservation: No rewrite of existing quote snapshots, accepted driver offers, completed orders, ledgers, returns or funding evidence.

missingSettings.pricing: Keep authenticated route distance and driving duration; price unavailable, never zero; no order until valid confirmed pricing.
missingSettings.preparation: Keep road data, omit full arrival ETA; proposed admission readiness guard must block missing/invalid preparation before accepting orders. Current preview allows null and must not be represented as already enforcing this guard.
missingSettings.minimum: Absence/null/0 currently means no minimum; malformed value is a readiness issue. Keep valid road data even when commerce metadata invalid.
missingSettings.coverage: No road quote claimed outside verified origin/destination coverage; do not guess nearest region or copy Fattoush location.
missingSettings.route: No straight-line value or fixed sample offered as a verified road route.
